name: Grademaxxing
subtitle: Grades, GPA & what-if planning
promotional_text: See your StudentVUE grades, explore assignment what-ifs, and plan your GPA with a native iPhone companion. Your school records stay read-only.
description:
See your grades. Explore your next move.

Grademaxxing is a native iPhone companion for compatible StudentVUE accounts. View your published grades and explore clearly labeled local estimates without changing school records.

YOUR GRADEBOOK
Browse courses, switch reporting periods, search assignments, and review published scores and category totals.

PLAN AHEAD
Try hypothetical assignments, edit local score estimates, and explore target scores. Compare unweighted and provisional weighted GPA estimates with editable course inclusion, credits, and rigor. Estimates depend on available grading information and may differ from your teacher's results.

SCHOOL INFORMATION
Read attendance, school calendar events, schedule, profile, documents, and available StudentVUE mail. Preview supported documents and attachments on demand. Reading mail does not mark it as read in StudentVUE.

TRY THE DEMO
Explore invented records before connecting a school account. No StudentVUE sign-in is needed for the built-in demo.

Requires iOS 17 or later and a compatible StudentVUE district account for connected features. Availability and record details vary by district. GPA calculations and what-if results are estimates, not official transcript values. StudentVUE remains the official source of school records.

Grademaxxing is independent of Edupoint and school districts. StudentVUE is a trademark of Edupoint Educational Systems LLC.
whats_new: The first native Grademaxxing release brings a read-only gradebook, assignment what-if planning, GPA estimates, school information, and a built-in synthetic demo to iPhone.
review_notes: Grademaxxing is an independent read-only StudentVUE companion. We request approval to use the built-in synthetic demo in lieu of a real school account because real accounts expose protected student information. From the sign-in screen, tap Explore the demo. All displayed records are invented, and demo mode makes no school requests. Use Grades, Attendance, Documents, and Mail in the tab bar. Open a course to try What-if estimate and Edit assignment estimates. The GPA calculator is on Gradebook and in the navigation menu. School records and Account are in the navigation menu. Account > Data and privacy explains native data handling; Account > Licenses and attribution contains the bundled license notices. Leave demo returns to sign-in. There is no purchase, account registration, or StudentVUE write operation in the native app.
